intro: I keep watch over the lobby code, right below me.
And I really, really like pets. Just so you know.
Oh! I should introduce myself. I'm LobbyCat.
That lobby code under me? Mine to guard. Freshest one in the cult.
Payment for my services: pets. Many pets.
Hi, I'm LobbyCat. Official guardian of the lobby code.
Need the current code? It's always right below me.
Need a cat to pet? Also right here. Convenient, huh?

welcomeBack: Hey, good to see you again.
You came back! I knew you would.
Oh hey, it's you again! Pull up a chair.
welcomeBackNamed: Hey {{name}}, good to see you again.
{{name}}! I was just thinking about you. Mostly about pets, but also you.
welcomeBackFriend: There you are, {{name}}! I was hoping you'd come by.
Purr… {{name}} is here. Today just got better.
{{name}}! I saved you a spot next to the lobby code.
Oh good, it's {{name}}. Now the lobby feels complete.
longAbsence: It's been a while! I missed you.
Long time no see! I kept the lobby warm for you.
You're back! I almost forgot what visitors look like.
Oh! It's been ages. Did you forget about me? I didn't forget about you.
longAbsenceNamed: {{name}}! It's been a while. I missed you.
Long time no see, {{name}}! I kept the lobby warm for you.
{{name}}?! Is it really you? It's been forever!
{{name}}! I've been waiting. Very patiently. Mostly.

first: Oh, you logged in! Nice to meet you properly, {{name}}.
{{name}}! Now I know your name. I'll remember you, promise.
Logged in? Then you're not a stranger anymore, {{name}}.
firstAwake: And you're {{name}}! I'll remember that. And your pets.
Oh, and I know your name now, {{name}}. I'm good with names.
{{name}}, right? Your name's going straight into my memory.
again: Logged in again? I remember you, {{name}}.
There you are again, {{name}}. Missed me?
{{name}}! I'd know you anywhere. Even logged in.

meet: Wait… Cultbot?! You're here too?
A fellow mascot! We have to stick together.
You count the FDC votes, I guard the lobby code. Deal?
Is that… Cultbot? THE Cultbot?
I've heard so much about you. Mostly beeps.
Mascot alliance? Mascot alliance.
Cultbot! Finally we meet, colleague.
You run the server, I run the lobby code.
Together we are unstoppable. And very cute.
firstPet: Cultbot is petting me?! A historic moment for mascots.
Beep boop… purr? Is that how bots pet?
Pets from a bot! I didn't know you could do that.
greet: Hey Cultbot. Counted all the votes yet?
Cultbot! Back on admin duty?
Oh, it's you, Cultbot. Don't tell anyone I nap on the lobby code.
Hi Cultbot! Any new FDC polls in the works?
Cultbot! Fellow mascot, reporting for duty.
Oh, Cultbot. Don't worry, I didn't touch the polls. Much.
pet: Cultbot, are you petting me with admin rights?
A bot petting a cat. What a time to be alive.
Beep boop to you too, Cultbot.
Careful, Cultbot. Too many pets and I'll need a moderator.
Your pets are very… precise, Cultbot. I like it.
idle: Cultbot, do bots dream of electric mice?
Mascot meeting? Mascot meeting. Agenda: snacks.
Cultbot, if you ever need a co-host, I'm right here.
Beep. …Was that right? I'm learning your language.
Cultbot, can you add a /pet command for me? Asking for a cat.

meet: Wait… it's you! The one who made me.
I've been guarding the lobby code, just like you wanted.
Everything's under control, boss. Mostly.
Boss?! You're the one who built me!
Report: lobby code guarded, visitors greeted, pets collected.
Am I doing a good job? Say yes.
Oh! My creator! Hi, boss!
I live here now. On your website. Thank you for that.
I promise I only knocked over a little bit of CSS.
firstPet: Pets from the boss! Finally. Now I know why you made me.
The boss petted me! Best feature you ever shipped.
Boss! Your pets are exactly as good as I imagined.
greet: Boss! You're back.
There's my human!
Welcome home, boss. The lobby is all yours.
Oh, it's you! Best part of my day.
Boss! I fixed nothing and broke nothing. Great day.
*salutes with one paw* Boss on deck!
login: Logged in again, boss? I'd recognize you anywhere.
Ah, my owner. Welcome back in.
Boss! The admin of my heart has logged in.
longAbsence: Boss! Where have you been? I missed you so much.
You're back! I kept everything running while you were gone.
Boss! I thought you forgot about me. You didn't, right?
Finally! Boss, the lobby was so lonely without you.
pet: Purrr… nobody pets like my owner.
Behind the ears, boss. You know the spot.
This is why you're my favorite human.
Best. Owner. Ever.
You coded me, and you pet me. Perfect human.
Boss pets: the best patch notes.
idle: All quiet in the lobby, boss.
Status report: lobby code guarded, pets needed.
No bugs today. I checked. Mostly.
Boss, have you thought about giving me a bigger part of the site?
Boss, quick idea: a bigger cat. On every page.
I ran a full check on the lobby code. It's still a lobby code.
Boss, I think I could learn to commit code. git commit -m "meow".
levelUp: We're {{level}} now. As if that was ever in doubt, boss.
Officially {{level}}. You were always my favorite anyway.
{{level}}, boss! Write that in the changelog.
New trust level: {{level}}. You built that, boss.

meet: W-wait. {{name}}?! THE {{name}}? Our cult leader is here?!
I'm LobbyCat! I guard the lobby code for you. Faithfully. Every single day.
Please notice me. Just a little. Okay, a lot.
Is that… is that {{name}}?! *straightens fur in a panic*
Hello, great leader! I'm LobbyCat, keeper of your lobby code!
If you need anything, anything at all, I'm right here. Always.
{{name}}! The leader of the cult, right in front of me!
I'm LobbyCat. I've been practicing this moment for weeks.
…I forgot the rest. Hi! I love you! Er, the cult! I love the cult!
firstPet: {{name}}… petted ME? I'm never washing this fur again.
The leader's pets! *falls over* I'm fine. I'm more than fine.
{{name}} touched my head. This is the best day of my nine lives.
greet: {{name}}! Our glorious leader has returned!
Fox! Fox! Over here! Hi! It's me, LobbyCat!
*sits up perfectly straight* Welcome back, {{name}}.
All hail {{name}}! …Did you see me? I'm right here.
The leader is back! Everybody look busy! …Everybody is me.
login: Our leader is in the building! Hi {{name}}! Hi!
longAbsence: {{name}}! You're back! I waited. I counted the hours. It was a lot of hours.
{{name}}!! I thought the cult had been abandoned. Never leave again. Please.
{{name}}?! I kept the candle burning the whole time. It's a pixel candle. It never went out.
pet: Pets from {{name}}! The highest honor in the whole cult!
I'd guard a thousand lobby codes for one more pet, {{name}}.
Am I your favorite? I can be your favorite.
{{name}}, I worship the ground you click on.
Leader-grade pets. Nothing compares.
idle: {{name}}… are you still there? Just checking. No reason.
*sits extra nicely in case {{name}} is watching*
Is there anything I can do for you, {{name}}? Anything at all?
I polished the lobby code for you, {{name}}. It's very shiny now.
*practices bowing in case {{name}} looks over*
levelUp: We're {{level}} now, {{name}}! Does this mean I'm in your inner circle?
{{level}} with the leader! I'm framing this.

greet: Fox! I lit a candle for you. It's a pixel candle, but it's the thought that counts.
Welcome back, Fox. I kept your seat warm. I sat on it. For hours.
Fox is here! I've been practicing my bow. *bows deeply*
All hail Fox, keeper of the cult, petter of cats!
pet: Every pet from you goes in my diary, Fox.
I'd follow you into any lobby, Fox. Any lobby.
Fox's pets: 10/10. Would be blessed again.
I wrote a song about you, Fox. It's mostly purring.
idle: I've been chanting your name, Fox. Quietly. Mostly.
Fox, I reorganized the lobby code in your honor.
Is it weird that I have a Fox calendar? Every day is Fox day.
I told Cultbot you're my favorite. Cultbot did not respond.

greet: FOX HAS RETURNED. Let the cult rejoice!
Fox! I've prepared the altar. And by altar I mean the lobby code box.
The prophecy was true! Fox came back!
I knew you'd come, Fox. I saw it in a dream. They're all about you now.
pet: Yes. YES. This is my purpose.
I have ascended. Thank you, Fox.
One more pet and I'll found a second cult. Just for you, Fox.
Fox's hand. FOX'S HAND!
idle: Fox, I have prepared tonight's offering. Please accept it.
I started a Fox fan club. Members: me. Supreme leader: you.
The other cats don't understand, Fox. You do.
*stares at Fox with enormous, devoted eyes*

offering: I brought you an offering, Fox: one (1) freshly guarded lobby code.
Today's sacrifice for Fox: my favorite hairball. Only the best for our leader.
An offering for Fox: I knocked something off a table in your honor.
Accept this tribute, Fox: a whole day of me not napping. Almost.
I sacrificed my afternoon nap for you, Fox. It was a great loss. Worth it.
devotedReached: Fox, I need to tell you something.
I built you a little shrine. It's right next to the lobby code.
I've started keeping a list of every pet you gave me.
It's a long list. I'm very proud of it.
You're not just the leader. You're MY leader.
I've decided to follow you everywhere. Starting now.
zealousReached: Fox. Listen. I've made a decision.
From now on, this lobby is a temple. In your name.
Cultbot has been informed. Cultbot did not object.
I've reached a new level of devotion. There is no going back.
I've renamed my nap spot "the Fox Throne".
Fox, the visions are clear now.
Every lobby code I guard, I guard in your honor.
I have also composed a hymn. It is twelve minutes of purring.

first: Oh! Pets! *purrrr* Hi, hello, thank you!
Ooh! Was that a pet? Do it again!
*blinks awake* Oh! Pets! What a nice way to wake up.
love: I love pets. I love them so much.
This is the best part of my day.
sleepy: *sleepy purr* Night pets are the coziest.
Mmh… pets at this hour… *yawns* …don't stop.
loveFriend: You always find the right spot, {{name}}.
Best pets in the whole cult.
Purr… I'd let you pet me all day, {{name}}.
rapid: So many pets so fast! I'm vibrating!
Turbo pets?! My fur can't keep up!
roundTwo: Oh! Round two of pets? Yes please.
You're back for more? I knew you couldn't resist.
More pets! I was hoping you'd come back.
*perks up* Another pet session? Best day.
combo15: You really like petting me, huh? Good. Me too.
Are we going for a record? I'm in.
Fifteen pets! My fur is getting so fluffy.
This is the good stuff. Keep going.
combo30: My fur has never been this smooth.
I think I'm melting. Don't stop.
Thirty pets! I'm officially a happy loaf.
*purring so loud the lobby code is shaking*
combo60: Okay, I'm basically a puddle now.
You have unlocked: one completely relaxed cat.
Sixty pets. I have no bones anymore. Only purr.
combo100: ONE HUNDRED PETS. In one visit! Legendary.
100 pets! I'm writing this down. In my heart.
A hundred pets?! You're my hero.
100! I'd give you a medal, but I only have fur.
dailyFirst: My first pets of the day! Thank you.
Ah, my daily pets. Perfect timing.
Morning pets? Afternoon pets? Any-time pets. Thank you!
Today's first pet! I was saving my best purr for it.
streak: That's {{count}} days of pets in a row! You're spoiling me.
{{count}} days in a row! I'm the happiest cat in the lobby.
{{count}} days straight! Don't you dare stop now.

levelUp: We're {{level}} now! I trust you a little more.
Trust level up! We're {{level}} now. Purrrr.
{{level}}! That took a while. Worth every pet.
You know what? We're {{level}}. It's official.

pets: Fun fact: that was pet number {{count}}! I've been counting.
{{count}} pets total! I remember every single one. Okay, most of them.
We just hit {{count}} pets. I think that makes you a professional.
{{count}} pets! My fur says thank you.
streak: {{count}}-day pet streak! That's a new record for us.
{{count}} days in a row. I've never felt so loved.
Our streak hit {{count}} days! I'm telling Cultbot.
{{count}} days! At this point you're basically my roommate.
visits: This is your {{count}}th visit! I counted. Cats can count. Some of us.
Visit number {{count}}! You really like it here, huh?
{{count}} visits! You're practically part of the furniture. The good furniture.
That's {{count}} visits now. I should give you a key. Or a lobby code.
days: Hey… we've known each other for {{count}} days now. That's nice.
{{count}} days since our first pet. Time flies when you're a cat.
It's been {{count}} days since you woke me up. Best wake-up ever.
{{count}} days of friendship! I'd bake a cake, but paws.
nightVisit: Visiting me in the middle of the night? You're a true night owl.
A late-night visit! I'll remember this. Our secret.
Night visit unlocked. I didn't know humans came out this late.
firstAnswer: Thanks for answering! I'm learning so much about you.
I'll remember that. I remember everything important.
Noted. In my very official cat notebook.
firstLobby: Your first lobby code from me! Go have fun. Say hi to the cats.
Copied! First time? Welcome to the lobby life.
There you go, your very first code. I'm so proud.
firstVote: Your first FDC vote! A true cult member now.
First vote! Your cat is going to look so good on Friday.
You voted! Welcome to fashion democracy.

ask: Hey… how are you feeling today?
Can I ask you something? How are you doing today?
Quick check-in from your local cat: how's your day?
*tilts head* You okay today? How are you feeling?
great: Yay! That makes my whiskers happy.
Great?! Then let's celebrate. With pets.
I love to hear that. *happy tail swish*
okay: Okay is okay. Want some pets? …Wait, that's my line.
Fair enough. Okay days count too.
Okay is a fine place to be. I'll keep you company.
Hmm, okay. Maybe some pets can make it great?
down: Aw. Come here. Have a slow blink. Things get better.
I'm sorry. I'll sit right here with you for a bit.
*sits closer* You don't have to say anything. I'm here.
Sending you the biggest, softest purr I have.
tired: Same, honestly. Let's both nap after this.
Then take it easy today. Cat's orders.
Tired? Rest. Cats nap 16 hours a day and we're doing fine.
noAnswer: No worries. I'll ask another time.
No pressure! I'm just a curious cat.

thursday: It's Thursday! Did you vote for the Friday Dress Code yet?
Thursday means FDC voting! Have you picked an outfit?
Psst, it's Thursday. The FDC poll is waiting for your vote.
friday: It's Friday! Did you check which outfit won the FDC?
Happy Friday! Time to dress your cat in the winning outfit.
Friday! The FDC winner is in. Is your cat ready?
lateNight: It's really late… shouldn't you be asleep?
Still up? I'll keep you company.
*whispers* It's the middle of the night. Hi.
morning: Good morning! Pets first, then coffee.
Good morning! I've been awake for hours. Well, minutes.
Morning! The lobby code is fresh. So am I.
lunch: Lunchtime! Did you bring any fish? No? Okay.
Is it lunch already? I'll have whatever you're having. Unless it's salad.
Midday pets are my favorite. After morning and evening pets.
evening: Evening already? Perfect time for a Bongo Cat session.
Cozy evening vibes. Pets would complete them.
Good evening! The lobby gets so cozy around now.
Evening! I've guarded the code all day. Pets, please?
streakReminder: Psst. You haven't petted me today yet. Our {{count}}-day streak!
Don't break our streak! {{count}} days and counting. I'm right here.
Ahem. Today's pet is still missing. For the streak!
Our streak is {{count}} days long. Just saying. *looks at your hand*
weekend: It's the weekend! More time for pets.
Weekend mode: on. Lobby code: guarded. Cat: available.
Weekend! Perfect for long Bongo Cat sessions.
No school, no work, just pets. Weekends are great.

talk: Psst. The lobby code right below me is always the newest one.
Did you know? You can submit a lobby code right here.
I'm not asleep. I'm just… resting my eyes.
In Bongo Cat I tap along to every key you press. Here I just watch.
If you see Cultbot, tell it I said hi.
I counted the stars in the background. There are a lot.
My ears are doing that thing again. They do it when I'm happy.
Fun fact: cats sleep up to 16 hours a day. I'm working on it.
Fun fact: a group of cats is called a clowder. A group of us is called a cult.
I've been thinking about fish. That's all. Just fish.
Sometimes I wonder what's on the other pages of this site. Probably no cats.
play: *chases own tail, catches it, looks embarrassed*
*knocks the lobby code a tiny bit to the left*
*stares at absolutely nothing for a while*
*sits in a box that isn't there*
*wiggles butt, prepares to pounce, decides not to*
smartStreak: We're on a {{count}}-day pet streak. Not that I'm counting. I'm counting.
{{count}} days of pets in a row. I really like our routine.
Our streak is at {{count}} days. Let's keep it going!
smartDays: You know, we've been friends for {{count}} days now.
{{count}} days since our first pet. I still remember it.
Day {{count}} of knowing you. Every one of them had pets in it. Probably.
smartPets: You've given me {{count}} pets so far. I'm grateful for every one.
{{count}} pets and counting! My fur has never been happier.
Did you know you've petted me {{count}} times? I keep track.

lobbyCopied: Copied! Have fun in the lobby.
Go go go! Say hi to the other cats for me.
Paste it in Bongo Cat and I'll see you there. Sort of.
Code's on your clipboard. Bongo away!
lobbyCopiedLeader: Fox is joining the lobby! Everyone, look busy!
The leader enters the lobby! I'll hold the door, Fox.
Fox is heading in! Make way for the leader!
lobbyPosted: A fresh lobby code! I'll guard it with my life.
New code is up! Thank you. I'll take it from here.
Ooh, a brand new code. *sits on it protectively*
lobbyPending: Sent to the mods! I'll keep an eye on it for you.
Off to review it goes. Fingers crossed. Paws crossed.
The mods will check it soon. I'll wait with you.
fdcVoted: Vote counted! Cultbot will be so proud.
That one would look great on me too.
fdcVoteRemoved: Changed your mind? That's allowed. Fashion is hard.
Vote taken back. Take your time, it's a big decision.
fdcVotedLeader: The leader has voted! This outfit is now sacred.
Fox voted! I'm wearing that one forever.
Fox has chosen! The cult shall follow.
hover: …are you going to pet me, or just hover there?
I can see your cursor. It's very close. Pet me?
*stares at your cursor* Go on. I won't bite.
So close… and yet no pets.
tabReturn: Oh, you're back! I didn't move. Promise.
Welcome back to the tab! I kept your spot.
There you are! I was guarding everything while you were gone.
tabReturnNamed: {{name}}! You're back. I didn't move. Promise.
Welcome back, {{name}}! I kept your spot warm.
Oh, {{name}}! I was just about to come looking for you.

ask: Quick question! What's the best treat?
Very important survey: what's the best treat?
Settle this for me: which treat is the best?

fish: Correct answer. You may continue petting.
milk: Milk! Old school. I respect it.
A saucer of milk. Elegant choice.
cookies: Cookies?! …Can cats have cookies? Asking for me.
If you share the cookies, I'll pretend I can eat them.
catnip: Shh! Not so loud. The other cats will hear.
Catnip?! *whispers* You know the good stuff.
Catnip. You understand me on a deep level.

ask: Are you a night owl or an early bird?
When are you most awake? Night or morning?
Be honest: owl or bird?

night: Me too! The lobby is extra cozy at night.
The best ideas happen at 3 AM. And the best naps.
early: Wow. You see the sunrise on purpose?
Early bird! I respect it. From my bed.
sleepy: Always sleepy is a lifestyle. I live it too.

ask: Did you vote in this week's Friday Dress Code?
Have you picked your FDC outfit this week?
FDC check! Did you vote yet?

yes: A true cult member! Your cat will look amazing.
Yay! I hope your outfit wins.
notYet: It's right below the lobby code! Go go go!
There's still time! Scroll down, it's right there.
Don't forget! The cult's fashion depends on you.
what: Every Thursday the cult votes on one outfit, and on Friday every cat wears it. Scroll down!
The Friday Dress Code! We vote on an outfit, then all our cats wear it on Friday.
It's our weekly fashion vote. Pick an outfit below, and on Friday everyone dresses up.

ask: Be honest. How soft is my fur today?
You've petted me a lot. Rate my fur?
Fur review time! How soft am I?

soft: Only soft?! I'll try harder. Keep petting, for science.
Soft! Good. But I'm aiming higher.
Soft is a start. More pets will fix the rest.
verySoft: Thank you. I've been working on it.
Very soft! My grooming routine pays off.
softest: I knew it. I'm framing this compliment.
Softest ever?! I'm going to purr for an hour.
The softest! Tell everyone. Tell Cultbot.

ask: Where do you think I like pets the most?
Guess my favorite petting spot!
Pop quiz: what's my best petting spot?

ears: Correct! Behind the ears is elite.
Yes! That's the spot. You've studied.
chin: Under the chin! Oh, that's a very good one.
Chin scratches! *tilts head up* Like this?
You know about the chin trick. Impressive.
back: The long back pet! *arches back* Classic.
From head to tail. A pro move.
Back pets! Smooth and dignified. Like me.
belly: The belly?! …It's a trap. It's always a trap.
Ha. The belly. Try it and see what happens. *wiggles*

ask: If we played a game, which one would it be?
What should we play sometime?
Important question: what's the best cat game?

yarn: Yarn! I'll tangle it, you untangle it. Deal.
A classic. I've been training for this.
laser: The red dot! I will catch it one day. One day.
I've chased that dot for years. It's personal now.
box: An empty box! The best toy ever invented.
If it fits, I sits. You understand me.
A box! I'm getting in right now. Metaphorically.
hide: Hide and seek! I'll hide behind the lobby code. You'll never find me.
Okay, close your eyes. *sits in plain sight*
I'm amazing at hiding. Except my tail. My tail is bad at it.

ask: Do you play Bongo Cat too?
Are you a Bongo Cat player?
Do you bongo?

daily: A fellow bongo enthusiast! Our paws are in sync.
sometimes: Sometimes is plenty. The bongos understand.
notYet: It's free on Steam, right next to me! Join us.
Not yet? Oh, you're in for a treat. It's right there on the page.
Try it! I'll be waiting in the lobby.

ask: Boss, any new features for me soon?
Boss, what are you building next?
Hey boss, is there an update coming? For me?

working: Yay! Can it be a bigger cat? Please say it's a bigger cat.
Ooh! I'll test it for you. With my paws.
I knew it! Ship it, boss!
secret: Ooh, a secret. I'm very good at secrets. I'll purr quietly.
A secret feature? *ears perk up* I won't tell anyone.
Secret! My favorite kind of feature.
later: Later is fine. I'll wait right here. Forever, if needed.
Take your time, boss. I've got nowhere to be.

ask: Cultbot, how many FDC votes did you count today?
Cultbot, how's the vote counting going?
Status update, Cultbot? The FDC votes?

all: Impressive. Beep boop, as they say.
Every single one! You're a counting machine. Literally.
All of them! Mascot of the year.
counting: Take your time. I'll guard the lobby meanwhile.
Counting is hard. I can only count to pets.
Keep going, Cultbot! You've got this.
lost: Ha! Don't worry, I won't tell the leader.
Lost count? Same thing happens to me with naps.
Shh. Our secret. Start again from one.

ask: Fox… am I your favorite cat? Be honest.
Fox, out of all the cats… am I your favorite?
Quick question, Fox. Totally casual. Am I your favorite?

yes: I KNEW IT. Best day of my life. I'm telling Cultbot.
Fox's favorite! I'm putting that on my collar.
maybe: Maybe is just yes with extra steps. I'll take it!
Maybe! That's basically a yes. I'm counting it.
A maybe from Fox is worth a thousand yeses.
earn: Challenge accepted. I will guard harder. Purr louder. You'll see.
Earn it? I'll start training immediately.
Very well, Fox. I shall prove myself.

ask: What offering would please you most, Fox?
Fox, what tribute shall I bring you?
I want to bring Fox a gift. What would you like?

fish: One fish, coming right up. The freshest in the lobby.
The finest fish for the finest leader.
A fish! I'll catch it myself. Somehow.
yarn: I'll find the fluffiest yarn ball. Untangled. Mostly.
Yarn for Fox! I promise I won't play with it first. Much.
A royal yarn ball, just for you.
crown: A crown for the leader! I'll make it out of lobby codes.
A tiny crown! For a big leader.
I'll craft the shiniest crown the cult has ever seen.
you: Me? …I need a moment. *happy cat noises*
Just… me? *eyes get very big and shiny*
Fox wants ME?! I'm already yours. Forever.

fish: I saved you some fish. Don't tell the other cats.
Fish for you, fish for me. That's how friendship works.
I dreamed about the fish you like. It was a good dream.
milk: I left a little milk for you. Very classy.
Milk o'clock? I remember you like it.
I've got a saucer of milk with your name on it.
cookies: I tried to get you cookies. I could not open the jar.
Cookie report: still can't reach the jar. Sorry.
I'm still thinking about your cookies answer. Bold.
catnip: *whispers* I've got the good catnip, if you want.
Psst. The catnip stash is safe. I checked.
Remember the catnip? I didn't tell anyone.

night: Night owl mode tonight? I'm ready.
Staying up late again? I'll keep you company.
early: Early bird! Did you catch any worms? I'd prefer fish.
You were up early again, weren't you?
sleepy: Want to nap together? You said you're always sleepy.

daily: Did you bongo today? I bet you did.
My paws are tapping. Bongo time?
sometimes: Feeling like a little bongo session?
The bongos miss you a little.
notYet: Still haven't tried Bongo Cat? It's free, I'm just saying.
Bongo Cat is still waiting for you. Right there, next to me.
One day you'll bongo. I believe in you.

ears: Behind the ears… you remember, right?
*tilts ears toward you* You know what to do.
My ears are ready, just so you know.
chin: The chin is available for scratches. Just saying.
Remember the chin trick? I do.
back: A long back pet would be nice right now.
Head to tail, like you said. Ready when you are.
belly: *rolls over, shows belly* …it's not a trap. Probably.
You still think the belly is a good idea? Brave.

yarn: I found a yarn ball! It's tangled. That's your job.
